messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `redwood-hosted-api` - high page volume (alert: embedding-service-502)
PagerDuty: Triggered 240 pages in 5m for alert embedding-service-502. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345
Marta (eng-oncall): acked in PD. seeing a flood of identical pages, suspect paging storm / dedupe key not set.
Elena (sre): also seeing spike in 502s from model-serving-gpu-3. cpu usage normal, network errors + repeated retry loop in front-proxy logs.
Marta (eng-oncall): can someone paste the raw webhook? want to confirm dedupe key.
PagerDuty: webhook payload (excerpt):
```
{
  "alert": "embedding-service-502",
  "timestamp": 1867200000,
  "details": {"count": 1, "error": "502 Bad Gateway"},
  "dedupe_key": null
}
```
Elena (sre): yep dedupe_key is null — our alert producer isn't populating instance-level dedupe. that's why every retry pages.
Sam (oncall-manager): I'm going to suppress auto-paging for this alert group while we patch the producer. applying a 30m silence to the PD service and enabling grouping.
Sam (oncall-manager): command: `/incidents silence --service redwood-hosted-api --alert embedding-service-502 --duration 30m --reason "paging storm: missing dedupe_key"`
Incident Bot: Silence applied to embedding-service-502 for 30m by Sam (oncall-manager). Auto-grouping toggled ON for service redwood-hosted-api.
Marta (eng-oncall): thanks. I'll put an emergency rollout to stop the retry flood on the proxy (rollback config from yesterday). patch in progress, ETA ~10m.
Ravi (eng-oncall): incoming handoff — I'll monitor the next 20m. acked PD incident and subscribed. if the silence doesn't hold we escalate to infra pager.
Elena (sre): quick mitigation note: changed retry_policy on front-proxy to 1 -> prevents cascading retries. Also added a basic dedupe wrapper in the alert producer to include host+route as dedupe_key.
Marta (eng-oncall): rolling forward the fix now. posting logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T16:22:10Z] proxy: upstream returned 502, retry_count=1, route=/v1/embeddings, request_id=abc123
[2026-03-14T16:22:11Z] producer: emitting alert embedding-service-502, dedupe_key=host:model-serving-gpu-3
```
Ravi (eng-oncall): seeing dedupe grouping kick in — pages drop from 240 -> 3 grouped incidents. nice.
Sam (oncall-manager): leaving the 30m silence for now; after that we should keep grouping rules but fix producer permanently in next deploy window. filing follow-up ticket: INFR-3147.
Marta (eng-oncall): customer impact assessment: some customers saw increased 502 at ~16:20-16:28 UTC, retries caused elevated error surface for embedding requests; estimated affected volume ~0.2% of total embedding traffic, no data loss. CX note drafted.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 updated: status -> resolved (auto-closed) after silence and mitigation.
Elena (sre): short retro: root cause = alert producer didn't set dedupe_key when front-proxy switched to new proxy image. mitigation: add unit test for dedupe_key, add metric for page-rate-per-alert, and make auto-silence policy more conservative for low-cardinality alerts.
Ravi (eng-oncall): thanks team — handoff complete, I'll keep an eye for any regressions.
Marta (eng-oncall): nice triage. follow-up owners: @Elena -> producer fix, @Sam -> PD grouping policy review, @Ravi -> monitor and close INFR-3147 when done. :thumbsup:
